question: Which materials are enumerated as suitable for vessels in this teaching?
premises: Clay is named as a material
Tortoise-derived, bell-metal, and copper-metal vessels are named
The goddess is addressed in the enumeration
inference: Vessels may be made of clay, tortoise-derived material, bell-metal, or copper metal.
plain_english: O Goddess, vessels made of clay, born of tortoise, made of bell-metal, and born of copper metal.
